newsitem.title: USA: Crown NorthCorp names Cooke pres, COO.
newsitem.headline: Crown NorthCorp names Cooke pres, COO.

text.p: Crown NorthCorp said Harold Cooke has joined the firm as president and chief operating officer.
He previously was senior vice president of the real estate finance group at Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp.
Ronald Roark, chairman and chief executive officer of Crown, had also been serving as acting president and chief operating officer of Crown since September 1996, the company said.
